fields.charts_active_customers_description:
Monthly added vs removed customers over the last 6 months.

Added: customers created with Active status in the month. Removed: customers set to Inactive in the month. Respects owner and business-unit filters.
fields.charts_aging_overdue_portfolio_descripti:
Overdue portfolio by days past due.

Groups customers with open collection periods and overdue invoices into aging buckets (0–7 through 365+ days). Shows amount and customer counts per bucket.
fields.charts_automated_phase_split_description:
Customers and invoices in each automated collection step.

Shows how accounts progress through the automated phase sequence for active collection periods in scope.
fields.charts_collected_vs_promise_description:
Collected payments vs promise-to-pay amounts by month (last 6 months).

Collected: sum of invoice payments in the month. Promise: sum of promise-to-pay amounts with promise date in the month.
fields.charts_collection_efforts_phase_descript:
Open collection workload by category.

Splits customers and invoices across Automated, Agent, Promise to Pay, Dispute, and Legal phases for active collection periods.
fields.operation_dashboard_description: Monitor collection agent performance and operational metrics
fields.stats_invoices_by_business_unit: Expected invoices amount by business unit (Top 10)
fields.stats_maturity_schedule_description:
Future Due invoices grouped by days until due date.

Buckets from 0–7 days through 365+ days. Uses outstanding balance per invoice in scope.
fields.stats_overdue_invoices_by_business_unit: Overdue invoice amount by business unit (Top 10)
fields.stats_total_collected_m_t_d_page_descrip:
Sum of invoice payment amounts recorded in the selected calendar month.

Includes payments linked to invoices for the account in scope.
fields.subtitle: Track your collection activities here.
fields.title: Dashboard

messages.credit_dashboard_forbidden: This page is not available. Credit insurance must be enabled and you need the View Credit Insurance Dashboard permission.
messages.credit_dashboard_load_failed: Failed to load Credit Insurance Dashboard.
messages.business_unit_access_denied: You do not have access to the selected business unit.
messages.error_loading_dashboard: Failed to load dashboard data. Please try again.
messages.no_agents_description: No collection agents found for your account or business unit. The dashboard will display data once collection agents are added and have activities in the selected date range.

tooltips.credit_insurance_health_index_rule:
Shows how much of open AR is compliant so you can judge overall cover quality at a glance.

Health index = (compliant exposure ÷ total receivables) × 100. Values under 1% show extra decimals so small compliant balances stay visible.
tooltips.credit_insurance_policy_usage_calculatio:
Each base column stacks Used (open receivables up to total approved limits), Remaining (unused approved-limit headroom), Top-Up Covered (above-base AR covered by active top-up), and Uncovered exposure (AR beyond approved limit plus active top-up).

Only approved eligible customers count (active, non-excluded, positive approved limit). Usage percentage is total open AR divided by total approved limits for that category, so the stacked segments always align with that percentage.

Columns: Total Limits Usage (Named + DCL/SDL), Named Limits Usage, and DCL/SDL Limits Usage. Top-Up (when shown) uses active resolved top-up cover.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_active_top_up_co:
Shows temporary extra cover in force so you know how much headroom depends on top-ups—and can renew or resize before it lapses.

Sum of resolved active top-up cover in account currency for in-scope customers with an active top-up (excluding outdated DCL and customers excluded from policy).

Click to open the top-up cover report.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_top_ups_expiring:
Flags top-ups ending soon so you can renew or re-size limits before temporary cover disappears.

Customers with at least one active top-up ending within the configured window. Urgent items (within 7 days) are highlighted.
tooltips.credit_insurance_terms_breach_chart_calc: Each bar counts open Due or Overdue invoices where that breach flag is set. One invoice can appear in multiple bars if several flags apply.
tooltips.credit_insurance_daily_trend_calculation:
End-of-day snapshots for the last {{days}} days: total receivables, compliant exposure, at-risk exposure, and health index.

Deltas compare the latest day to the previous snapshot.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_total_receivable:
Sizes the open book in scope so you know how much AR you are managing under the current filters.

Sum of open receivables (Due + Overdue) for customers in the selected dashboard scope (policy, business unit, and no-policy toggle).
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_compliant_exposu:
Shows the portion of open AR treated as compliant so you can separate covered quality from problem exposure.

Total receivables minus at-risk exposure.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_at_risk_exposure:
Surfaces non-compliant open AR so you can prioritize limit gaps, terms breaches, or missing-policy remediation.

No linked policy or pending-review exclusion: full open AR (same cohort as No Policy Exposure).

All other customers: Cap Gap + Terms Breach − overlap (Σ min(invoice capacity gap, invoice terms breach) on open Due/Overdue invoices). Matches Cap Gap and Terms Breach cards and never exceeds their sum.

Portfolio total is the sum of customer at-risk only.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_overdue_block:
Counts customers past the MEP overdue deadline so you can act on blocked or late reporting risk early.

Flagged when today is past (oldest overdue invoice due date + max allowed MEP days).
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_capacity_gap:
Shows how far open AR exceeds effective limits so you can size limit increases or top-ups.

Sum across customers of max(0, open AR − effective limit). Effective limit = approved limit + active top-up.

Secondary line: customers with a positive limit-currency gap.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_at_risk_exposure:
Shows this customer’s non-compliant open AR so you know what needs remediation first.

No linked policy or pending-review exclusion: full open AR.

Otherwise: Cap Gap + Terms Breach − overlap on open Due/Overdue invoices.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_capacity_gap:
Shows how far this customer’s open AR exceeds the effective limit so you can decide on a limit increase or top-up.

max(0, open AR − effective limit). Effective limit = approved limit + active top-up.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_health_index:
Shows how much of this customer’s open AR is compliant so you can judge cover quality at a glance.

(compliant exposure ÷ total receivables) × 100. Values under 1% show extra decimals.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_ar_volatility:
Shows how jumpy this customer’s daily AR is so you can investigate spikes separately from trend.

σ of day-over-day % AR change on consecutive available days (gaps and carried-forward days excluded). Extreme ±10% moves are listed separately.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_policy_usage:
Shows how hard this customer is using approved limit(s) so you can spot near-limit or over-limit pressure early.

Open AR as a % of approved limit(s) for active policies in scope (display capped at 999.99%).
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_policy_ar_share:
Shows this customer’s weight on the shared policy so you can judge single-name concentration risk.

Customer open AR ÷ policy total open AR on the latest available CTP snapshot.
tooltips.customer_credit_forecast_trending_away: Usage trend is moving away from {{threshold}}%
tooltips.customer_credit_forecast_suppressed: Limit-breach forecast suppressed (short window or low R²)
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_limit_breach_fore:
Projects when trailing usage % may cross 150% or 200% so you can act before a structural breach.

OLS fit on trailing ~30 available days; shown only when trending toward the threshold and R² is above the floor. Dates use whole days—no false sub-day precision.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_active_policies:
Shows how many active policy links apply so you know which cover relationships are in play for this customer.

Count of active Customer Policy rows in the selected policy filter (or all linked policies when unfiltered).
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_terms_breach:
Shows outstanding on invoices with terms breaches so you can prioritize policy-condition cleanup.

Outstanding on open Due/Overdue invoices with any terms-breach flag, plus invoice count (counts can overlap across breach types).

Streak badge: breach-free / in-breach N days after a past episode, or “no breach on record” when never breached in available history (missing days excluded).
tooltips.customer_credit_risk_exposure_chart:
End-of-day open AR, at-risk exposure, and risk drivers for this customer by linked policy, from Customer Policy Trend snapshots.

Solid blue: open AR. Solid dark: at-risk (Cap Gap + Terms Breach − overlap). Dashed red: capacity gap. Dashed amber: terms breach outstanding.
tooltips.customer_credit_terms_breach_chart: Each slice counts open Due or Overdue invoices where that breach flag is set. One invoice can appear in multiple slices if several flags apply.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_terms_breach_amo:
Shows outstanding on terms-breaching invoices so you can prioritize policy-condition remediation across the portfolio.

Outstanding on open Due/Overdue invoices with any terms-breach flag, plus invoice count (counts can overlap).
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_no_policy_exposu:
Shows open AR without active linked cover so you can decide who needs a policy link or review.

Open receivables for customers without an active linked insurance policy (including pending policy review).
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_reporting_countd:
Flags invoices nearing their reporting deadline so you can report before a reporting breach.

Open Due/Overdue invoices with target reporting date in the forward window, not yet reported, and not already flagged as reporting breach.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_limit_warnings:
Unique customers in scope at or above the configured warning % of limit (effective limit when top-up applies), still at or below 100%; and/or with a credit score expiring within the configured days; and/or with an approved limit expiring within the configured days.

Over-limit customers appear in Capacity gap only.
tooltips.credit_insurance_metric_zero_limit_warni:
Flags active policies with a zero approved limit so you can fix missing or blocked cover setups.

Count of active CustomerPolicy rows in scope with approved limit of 0.
tooltips.credit_insurance_limit_usage_trend_chart: Daily portfolio limit usage: total open AR divided by total approved limits across insured customers (from Customer Policy Trend snapshots). Reference lines at 80% and 100%.
tooltips.credit_insurance_top_customers_usage_cha:
Top 10 insured customers by current open AR from today's Customer Policy Trend snapshot.

Bar width reflects usage % (open AR ÷ approved limit, or ÷ effective limit when top-up applies). Hover for AR, limits, and usage breakdown.
tooltips.credit_insurance_coverage_alerts_card:
Lists recent coverage alerts so you can jump straight to the related remediation report.

Covers limits, reporting, policy dates, and similar events for the selected policy scope.
tooltips.promise_fulfillment_rate_tooltip:
Total: collection periods with a completed Promise to Pay activity in the selected date range.

Fulfillment rate = (periods that left Promise to Pay—previous category Promise_to_pay, modified in range) ÷ total promises × 100.
tooltips.financial_metric_overdue_customers:
Count of customers with overdue outstanding balance in scope.

Based on customers with overdue invoices; respects owner, business unit, and parent/child view mode.
tooltips.financial_metric_overdue_amount:
Sum of overdue outstanding amounts for customers in scope.

Aggregated from overdue invoices; respects owner, business unit, and view mode.
tooltips.financial_metric_overdue_invoices:
Count of unpaid invoices past due date.

Status not Paid/Void/Cancelled, due date before today, for customers with an active collection period.
tooltips.financial_metric_total_collected_mtd:
Sum of invoice payment amounts in the current calendar month.

All payments linked to invoices for the account (not filtered by customer owner/BU on the payment).
tooltips.financial_metric_total_due:
Sum of outstanding on all Due-status invoices in scope.

Uses outstanding_debt, or customer_outstanding_debt when outstanding_debt is zero.
tooltips.financial_metric_due_today:
Sum of outstanding on Due invoices with due date today.

Calendar day in server timezone; uses outstanding_debt with customer_outstanding_debt fallback.
tooltips.financial_metric_due_this_week:
Sum of outstanding on Due invoices due from today through end of the current week.

Week starts Sunday; excludes invoices already past due.
tooltips.financial_metric_due_this_month:
Sum of outstanding on Due invoices due from today through end of the current month.

Excludes invoices already past due.
tooltips.financial_metric_due_next_month:
Sum of outstanding on Due invoices with due date in the next calendar month.

Uses outstanding_debt with customer_outstanding_debt fallback.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_top_up_value:
Shows temporary extra cover on this customer so you know how much headroom depends on top-ups.

Resolved active top-up cover amount for this customer.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_top_up_usage:
Shows how much of the top-up layer is already used so you can renew or resize before temporary cover runs out.

Open AR above the base approved limit as a % of active top-up cover.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_effective_usage:
Shows usage against the effective limit (approved + top-up) so you can judge true headroom including temporary cover.

Open AR ÷ effective limit × 100 for active policies in scope.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_utilization_overs:
Shows how far past 100% utilization this customer typically runs so you can size a structural limit resize—not only that usage is over 100%.

Mean of max(0, effective usage % − 100) over available days with a positive effective limit. Peak usage and max overshoot date are shown in the subtext; sparkline is daily overshoot points.
tooltips.customer_credit_limit_capped_banner: Compliant exposure is capped near the limit — AR growth (+{{arGrowth}}%) is flowing into at-risk exposure, not compliant (+{{compliantGrowth}}%).
tooltips.customer_credit_limit_capped_chart_help: Both series are scaled to their own min–max so divergence is visible even at different money scales. Shown only when the limit-capped flag fires.
tooltips.customer_credit_breach_diluted_banner: Health rose while breach $ stayed elevated ({{breachFirst}} → {{breachLast}}) and AR grew +{{arGrowth}}% — improvement looks diluted, not resolved.
tooltips.customer_credit_breach_resolved_banner: Health rose as breach $ fell sharply ({{breachFirst}} → {{breachLast}}, {{breachChange}}%) — recovery looks resolved, not diluted by AR growth.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_breach_dilution:
Separates genuine recovery from health that only improved because AR grew while breach $ stayed elevated.

Shown when health rises with breach history: diluted (persistent breach + AR growth) vs resolved (breach fell sharply). Never-breached customers are N/A.
tooltips.customer_credit_metric_breach_streak:
Shows whether terms breaches are currently open, recently cleared, or never present so you judge trust rebuilding after breaches.

Breach-free N days / in breach N days after a past episode; “no breach on record” when never breached in available history (missing days excluded).

credit_insurance_dashboard.limit_warnings_subtitle: At ≥ {{threshold_pct}}% of limit (not over) or credit score expiring in {{score_warn_days}} days.
credit_insurance_dashboard.zero_limit_warning_subtitle: Approved limit is 0 and active policy.
credit_insurance_dashboard.page_description: Review health index, exposure, capacity gap, terms breaches, and reporting obligations.
credit_insurance_dashboard.policy_max_cover_exceeded_with_policy: Policy <policy>{{policy}}</policy>: Total AR exceeded Policy Max Cover by {{amount}}
credit_insurance_dashboard.policy_max_cover_exceeded_single: Total AR exceeded Policy Max Cover by {{amount}}
credit_insurance_dashboard.top_customers_usage_vs_limit_empty: No current customer limit usage data available.
credit_insurance_dashboard.limit_usage_trend_empty: No usage snapshots yet. Run the Customer Policy Trend daily job or check back after a few days.
credit_insurance_dashboard.reporting_countdown_subtitle: Open invoices to report within the next {{days}} days (by target reporting date).
credit_insurance_dashboard.terms_breach_chart_caption: Invoices with each breach flag; one invoice can appear in multiple categories.
credit_insurance_dashboard.terms_breach_chart_subtitle: Terms Breach — Count By Breach Type
credit_insurance_dashboard.trend_empty_chart_hint: No daily snapshot data yet. The chart will appear after snapshots are recorded.
credit_insurance_dashboard.trend_history_load_failed: Unable to load daily trend (request failed). Open the network tab and check {{path}}.

credit_insurance_report.description_capacity: Customers where open AR exceeds the approved limit and the effective uninsured gap.
credit_insurance_report.description_limit_warning: Customers at or above the configured % of approved limit (and not over 100%), and/or with credit score expiring within the configured warning days. Over-limit customers appear in Capacity gap only.
credit_insurance_report.description_overdue: List of customers in overdue block, outstanding exposure, and aging signals for the selected view.
credit_insurance_report.description_policy_risk: Insured customers with open AR: capacity gap, terms-breach outstanding, and allocated policy risk (min of AR vs gap + breach), matching the dashboard card.
credit_insurance_report.description_reported: Invoices for which a reporting date has been recorded.
credit_insurance_report.description_reporting: Open invoices to report to the insurer within the window set on your account (by target reporting date; past-due unreported items move to terms breach).
credit_insurance_report.description_terms: Open invoices in due or overdue status with reporting or policy terms breaches.
credit_insurance_report.load_summary_failed: Failed to load credit insurance summary. Try again later.
credit_insurance_report.summary_reported_hint: Invoices reported to the insurer. Use search to find a specific invoice.
credit_insurance_report.description_zero_limit_warning: Customers with an approved limit of 0 and an active policy.
credit_insurance_report.description_top_up: Customers with active top-up cover: base approved limit, top-up amount, and effective limit.
credit_insurance_report.description_top_up_expiring: Active top-ups ending within the selected window (default 30 days).
credit_insurance_report.description_no_policy_exposure: Customers with open AR who have no linked insurance policy or are excluded with reason Pending review.
credit_insurance_report.description_utilization_bin: Approved customers in the selected utilization band by mean daily effective utilization over the portfolio-health date range. Utilization % and usage are period averages.
credit_insurance_report.description_ar_extreme_moves: Approved customers with at least one extreme day-over-day AR move (±10%), plus volatility σ, carried-forward days, and health slope.
credit_insurance_report.bulk_mark_description: Apply the same reporting date and reference to {{count}} selected invoice(s). They will be recorded as reported at the same time.
credit_insurance_report.bulk_export_selected_hint: Download the selected rows in list order for submission
credit_insurance_report.description_utilization_overshoot: Approved customers with a positive effective limit in the date range, ranked by average utilization above 100%. Includes max overshoot, avg/peak usage, days above limit, and longest streak.
credit_insurance_report.description_limit_capped: Customers where compliant exposure stayed flat while total AR grew (limit-capped). Includes AR vs compliant growth % and coefficients of variation.
credit_insurance_report.description_negative_daily_cost: Customers with anomalous negative policy/total daily cost entries above the minimum magnitude. Includes entry count, sum, and worst amount/date.
credit_insurance_report.description_exposure_reconciliation: Customers with CTP rows where at-risk + compliant do not match total AR, or at-risk exceeds total AR.
credit_insurance_report.description_policy_concentration: Customers ranked by share of policy open AR on the latest snapshot in range. Top-1 / top-3 shares and concentration alert (multi-customer policies only).
credit_insurance_report.description_limit_breach_forecast: Customers projected to cross 150% or 200% utilization from a trailing usage trend (R² floor applied). Clearly labeled as projected—not actual near-limit warnings.
credit_insurance_report.description_breach_dilution: Customers whose health rose while breach $ stayed elevated and AR grew (dilution). Never-breached customers are excluded. Includes breach and AR trend fields.
credit_insurance_report.description_breach_episodes: Customers with terms-breach episodes in the date range. Includes streak status, episode count, last episode start/end/duration/peak, and a summary of all episodes.

credit_portfolio_health.page_description: Period analytics for portfolio health, coverage, utilization, and cost.
credit_portfolio_health.generate_recent_snapshots_tooltip: Rebuilds portfolio health for the pending rewrite window ({{from}} – {{to}}). Does not use the page date range. Ignore reporting breach applies only to this run; nightly may rewrite the same days later with reporting-late counted.
credit_portfolio_health.generate_recent_disabled_reason: No pending rewrite window. Generate recent is available after an import enqueues days for nightly rewrite.
credit_portfolio_health.ignore_reporting_breach_tooltip: Only this Generate or Generate recent run. Snapshots treat reporting-late as off. Invoice records stay unchanged. After Generate recent, nightly drain may still rewrite the same days later with reporting-late counted while the queue stays pending.
credit_portfolio_health.large_range_confirm: Generate {{days}} days of snapshot history? This can take a while on large accounts.
credit_portfolio_health.generate_already_running: A generate job is already running. Use Stop, then Retry to resume, or wait for it to finish.
credit_portfolio_health.generate_snapshots_tooltip: Builds daily portfolio health snapshots for the selected date range. Runs in the background — use Stop to pause and Resume to continue.
credit_portfolio_health.policy_summary_empty_no_policies: No assigned policies on this account.
credit_portfolio_health.policy_summary_load_failed: Could not load the policy summary.
credit_portfolio_health.section_health_description: Dual Health series over the selected period. Series A uses the current filter scope; Series B removes customers with exclusion reason Insurer declined only.
credit_portfolio_health.series_a_subtitle: Includes all customers in the current policy, business unit, and no-policy cohort filters.
credit_portfolio_health.series_b_subtitle: Same as Health A, minus customers excluded because the insurer declined coverage.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_average_health_help:
Shows period average portfolio health so you can judge whether cover quality is acceptable over the range—not only today’s snapshot.

Mean of daily (compliant ÷ total AR × 100) over available days.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_lowest_health_help:
Shows the worst health day and how long it lasted so you can tell a brief dip from a prolonged trough.

Minimum daily health and longest consecutive streak at that exact value.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_pct_below_85_help:
Shows how often health stayed below your threshold so you can size persistent weakness in the book.

Share of available days below {{pct}}%. Missing days are excluded from the denominator.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_longest_over_limit_streak_help:
Surfaces the worst persistent over-limit run so you open the customer with the longest capacity breach first.

Longest consecutive available-day streak with capacity gap > 0 (gaps in snapshots break the streak).
credit_portfolio_health.monthly_chart_title: Monthly trend — total exposure, covered vs. uncovered
credit_portfolio_health.monthly_chart_help: Average daily open AR, compliant (covered), and at-risk (uncovered) amounts per calendar month in the selected range. Light red fill between the covered and total lines.
credit_portfolio_health.no_chart_data: No monthly history in this range.
credit_portfolio_health.section_no_coverage_description: Uncovered exposure (no linked policy or any exclusion reason), reason breakdown, and terms-breach violations on approved customers only.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_uncovered_exposure_help:
Shows uncovered customer share and AR so you can prioritize who still needs a policy link or exclusion review.

Customer %: mean daily share with no linked policy or any exclusion. Amount: mean daily open AR for that cohort.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_uncovered_customer_pct_help:
Shows the share of customers without cover so you can gauge how widespread self-underwriting is.

Mean daily share with no linked policy or any exclusion reason.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_uncovered_amount_help:
Shows uncovered open AR so you can size the monetary risk outside insurer cover.

Mean daily open AR for the uncovered cohort over available days.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_violation_pct_help:
Shows how much approved AR sits in terms breach so you can prioritize policy-condition cleanup.

Mean of daily (terms-breach AR ÷ approved total AR × 100). Uncovered customers excluded.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_main_violation_help:
Names the leading breach cause so you know which condition to fix first across the portfolio.

Reason with the largest summed terms-breach amount among approved customers, and its share of total breach amount.
credit_portfolio_health.no_coverage_reasons_title: Reasons for lack of coverage (by amount)
credit_portfolio_health.section_utilization_description: Effective limit utilization for approved customers, self vs approved footprint, top-ups, efficiency, and usage distribution.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_avg_utilization_help:
Shows average limit usage so you can see whether the book is comfortably under limit or chronically tight.

Mean of daily (usage ÷ effective approved limit × 100) for approved customers.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_avg_utilization_top10_help:
Shows average utilization of the largest customers by open AR so you can see concentration risk among the biggest names.

Unweighted mean of each of those customers’ period-average utilization %. Same 10 names as Coverage — 10 largest customers. Customers without an effective limit are excluded. Subtext is their share of mean daily DCL + Named open AR.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_pct_days_above_100_help:
Shows how often the portfolio ran over limit so you can prioritize chronic over-limit pressure.

Share of available days where effective utilization exceeded 100%.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_peak_utilization_help:
Shows the highest utilization peak and how long it held so you can size the worst squeeze in the period.

Highest daily effective utilization and longest streak at that exact peak.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_self_customer_pct_help:
Shows the share of self-underwritten customers so you can see how much of the book sits outside insurer cover.

Mean daily share with no linked policy or any exclusion. No limit-utilization % for this cohort.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_self_ar_share_help:
Shows self-underwritten AR share so you can size monetary exposure outside insurer cover.

Mean daily monetary share of open AR in the uncovered cohort.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_approved_customer_pct_help:
Shows the share of insurer-approved customers so you can see how much of the book is under policy cover.

Mean daily share with a linked policy and no exclusion reason.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_approved_ar_share_help:
Shows approved AR share so you can size how much open AR sits under insurer cover.

Mean daily monetary share of open AR for approved customers.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_self_footprint_help:
Summarizes self-underwriting footprint (customers + AR) so you can judge how large the uncovered book is.

Mean daily shares plus mean daily AR for the uncovered cohort.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_approved_footprint_help:
Summarizes insurer-approved footprint (customers + AR) so you can judge how large the covered book is.

Mean daily shares plus mean daily AR for approved customers.
credit_portfolio_health.footprint_covered_only_remark: Calculation includes only covered customers (Named + DCL).
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_top_ups_help:
Shows top-up activity so you can see how much of the book depends on temporary extra cover.

Top-up count and average customers with top-up.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_top_up_count_help:
Counts top-up policies active in the period so you know how widespread temporary cover is.

Policies active at any point in the selected range.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_top_up_customers_help:
Counts customers relying on top-ups so you can prioritize renewals where temporary cover props up limits.

Average daily customers with at least one active top-up.
credit_portfolio_health.top_customers_help: Top 10 by mean daily open AR in the range. Bars show mean daily effective utilization %.
credit_portfolio_health.distribution_help: Among {{count}} approved customers with a positive effective limit on at least one day in the range. Binned by mean daily effective utilization %. Grouped bars: share of customers and share of mean usage. Exclusive bins; each series sums to ~100%.
credit_portfolio_health.daily_health_chart_help: Daily portfolio health (compliant AR ÷ total open AR × 100). Violet line: period average. Red line: below-threshold cut-off ({{pct}}%). Red fill under the health line when period average is below 100%.
credit_portfolio_health.daily_util_chart_help: Daily effective utilization (usage ÷ effective approved limit × 100) for the portfolio, Named, and DCL cohorts among approved customers.
credit_portfolio_health.no_coverage_reasons_help: Average daily uncovered open AR by exclusion reason (or no linked policy) over available days in the range.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_violations_help:
Combines average violation rate and leading cause so you can prioritize the highest-impact terms cleanup.

Mean daily terms-breach rate on approved AR; leading cause by summed breach amount and its share.
credit_portfolio_health.section_costs_description: Period policy cost including top-ups, effective cost per compliant exposure, and self vs approved footprint.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_period_cost_help:
Shows total policy cost for the period so you can weigh insurance spend against the cover you received.

Issued sales × cost % + annualized limit cost + registration % of premium + amortized top-ups.
credit_portfolio_health.monthly_cost_chart_help: Same as period Policy cost, scoped to each calendar month (issued sales, annualized limit days, registration as a percent of the insurance premium, and amortized top-ups).
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_effective_cost_help:
Shows cost per unit of compliant exposure so you can compare insurance efficiency across periods or policies.

Period cost ÷ average daily compliant exposure.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_annual_credit_assessment_cost_help:
Shows the Annual Credit Assessment Fee burden for Named customers in the selected range so you can see the cost of named cover separately from Policy premium.

Each policy’s current fee × customers named anytime in the range × whole years (ceil days÷365, minimum 1). Null fee counts as $0.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_idle_named_customers_help:
Shows Named customers with no positive open AR on any day they were named in the selected range — including named customers who had no daily open AR snapshot in the range — so you can see the cost of unused named cover.

Count and share vs all Named in that set (CPT named-in-range plus current NamedPolicy roster; DCL excluded). Assessment cost uses each policy’s current fee × idle count × whole years (ceil days÷365, minimum 1). Null fee counts as $0.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_deductible_help:
Reserved for deductible tracking once configured—so you can see retained risk alongside premium cost.

Not configured yet.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_negative_cost_help:
Surfaces negative daily cost rows so credits/refunds do not hide inside the period total. Only entries at or above the minimum magnitude are flagged; the Policy cost total is unchanged.

Counts CTP rows with policy_daily_cost or total_daily_cost negative beyond the threshold.
credit_portfolio_health.negative_cost_table_help: Flagged negative daily cost rows (customer, date, amount), sorted by magnitude. Export opens the full customer cohort report.
credit_portfolio_health.policy_summary_max_cover_help: Shows the policy’s maximum total cover so you know the insurer’s overall capacity ceiling for this policy.
credit_portfolio_health.policy_summary_dcl_cover_help: Shows the max DCL/SDL cover band so you can judge discretionary-limit capacity under this policy.
credit_portfolio_health.policy_summary_cost_help: Shows the insurance fee rate (and related cost method) so you can understand premium economics for this policy.
credit_portfolio_health.stale_carried_forward_footnote: {{count}} snapshot-days were carried forward with no new activity.
credit_portfolio_health.exposure_reconciliation_footnote: {{count}} snapshot rows failed exposure reconciliation (max discrepancy {{maxDelta}}).
credit_portfolio_health.at_risk_exceeds_total_footnote: {{count}} rows have at-risk exposure greater than total AR (max excess {{maxExcess}}).
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_ar_volatility_help:
Shows how jumpy customer AR is across the book so you investigate spikes separately from trend.

Mean of each approved customer’s day-over-day AR % swing (σ). Extreme ±10% moves are in the drill-down; stale days are excluded.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_ar_volatility_label: Mean customer daily AR swing · {{count}} with extreme moves
credit_portfolio_health.overshoot_ranking_help: Customers ranked by average utilization above 100%. Click a row to open the customer; export opens the full sortable report. Null-limit customers are excluded.
credit_portfolio_health.overshoot_ranking_empty: No customers with effective-limit days in this range.
credit_portfolio_health.kpi_diluted_count_help:
Counts customers whose health rose while breach $ stayed elevated and AR grew—so the “improvement” may be dilution, not resolution.

Never-breached customers are excluded. Open the report for the filterable queue.
